system.title: Recorded commentary pipeline
system.description: Video frames pass through a vision observer into shared timestamped evidence. Optional squad context supplies identities. A coordinator routes caller and analyst turns, checks proposed lines, and saves captions and traces.
system.source:
flowchart LR V["Video
frames"] --> O["Vision
observer"] R["Optional
squad context"] -.-> O O --> E["Timestamped
evidence"] R -.-> E E --> C[Coordinator] C --> P[Caller] C --> A[Analyst] P --> G["Evidence +
timing checks"] A --> G G --> S["Captions +
run trace"]

turn.title: One speaking-agent turn
turn.description: A caller or analyst receives a snapshot and chooses a tool request, speech, or abstention. Allowed tools return context to the same role within its action budget. Proposed speech must pass application checks before it is kept.
turn.source:
flowchart LR S["Evidence snapshot +
recent dialogue"] --> D{Agent action} D -->|Request context| T[Allowed read-only tool] T -->|Result within action budget| S D -->|Speak| V["Validate citations,
role and word budget"] D -->|Abstain| Q[Record no speech] V -->|Pass| K[Keep line + audit trace] V -->|Fail| Q
